methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The study analyzes the Pearson Correlation Coefficient among the implementation benefits of ISO 50001, SDG scores, and the factors of the Network Readiness Index (NRI), etc.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper correlates country-level ISO 50001 implementation benefits, SDG scores, and readiness indicators but does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study encompasses an analysis of the Pearson Correlation Coefficient to understand the relationship among ISO 50001, SDGs, and the principles of Industry 4.0.

stage1.notes: Country-level correlational sustainability study; no EnPI/EnB model content.
